summary: Tested Admin Workstation + Feedback Widget (DIYhomie iter 10). Backend: 11/11 pytest passing for RBAC, feedback POST + admin PATCH/DELETE + filter, support tickets list/status, blog list/toggle/delete and public /api/blog unpublish reflection. Frontend (mobile + desktop): seeded admin login works (is_admin=true); feedback-fab visible on tabs and not blocking tab bar; full feedback submit flow (fab → type chip → input → submit → feedback-done thank-you) works; admin menu item only shows for admin; /admin workstation loads with left sidebar at >=760px and renders all 4 modules (admin-nav-overview/feedback/tickets/blog) with all required testIDs (fb-filter-*, status-*, fb-del-*, blog-toggle-*, blog-del-*, admin-exit). All admin endpoints return 200 for admin, 403 for normal user. No console errors during E2E. No deprecated Expo packages detected on the new code (FeedbackFab uses expo-haptics only).

minor.issue: Returns 200 even for non-existent slug (delete_one matched=0). Idempotent but inconsistent with PATCH which returns 404.
Same: returns 200 for unknown id. Consider 404 for consistency.

issues: When width < 760, top horizontal nav has no 'Back to app' shortcut (admin-exit is wide-only). Mobile admin users have no in-app way to leave /admin without using browser back.

action_items: (Minor) Make DELETE /api/admin/blog/{slug} and /api/admin/feedback/{fid} return 404 when matched_count == 0 for API consistency.
(UX) Show admin-exit (or equivalent 'Back to app') in the narrow/mobile admin top-nav so mobile admins can exit without browser back.
(Cosmetic) bcrypt '__about__' WARNING is noise in backend logs — already documented as harmless; can be suppressed by pinning bcrypt or upgrading passlib in a future cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: FeedbackFab renders correctly only when user is logged-in (returns null otherwise) — verified.
AdminLayout correctly redirects non-admin / unauthenticated to /(tabs) via expo-router Redirect.
menu-admin is gated by user?.is_admin in AppMenu — verified visible for admin only.
Feedback POST trims/strips, rejects empty messages (400), caps message at 4000 chars and screenshot at 2MB — good.
Admin endpoints all protected with require_admin dependency — RBAC verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin nav, feedback submit, RBAC redirect all working)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created 1 throwaway user (TEST_admin_review_*), 1 feedback (deleted in same run), 1 support ticket (left in DB with cleanup-safe TEST_ prefix). UI tests submitted 1 additional TEST_UI feedback via the FAB (still in feedback collection as 'new').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testIDs are auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button. To reach AppMenu use testID home-menu (not menu-open). Admin workstation: visit /admin after login (sidebar at >=760, top scroller below). All admin testIDs confirmed: admin-nav-{overview|feedback|tickets|blog}, admin-exit, admin-refresh, fb-filter-{all|new|in_progress|planned|done|declined}, status-{new|in_progress|planned|done|declined|open|closed}, fb-del-<id>, blog-toggle-<slug>, blog-del-<slug>. FeedbackFab renders 2 DOM nodes for testID feedback-fab (react-native-web Pressable wrapping) — use .locator(...).first or :first-of-type.
rca_of_issue: n/a — review request was validation only; no bugs blocking the new features. The two minor backend inconsistencies (DELETE 200 vs 404) are pre-existing API design choices and not regressions.
